title: The Two Bicliques Problem is in NP intersection coNP
review_status: full-text audit complete; exact decision problem, NP∩coNP theorem, cover-versus-partition distinction, and complexity-class caveat checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4 version inspected; venue not verified; internal date/header discrepancy noted
evidence_note: Vertex cover by at most two bicliques is shown in NP∩coNP, not P; the related partition problem remains open in the paper. NP∩coNP must not be paraphrased as an efficient algorithm.

title: Contraction: a Unified Perspective of Correlation Decay and Zero-Freeness of 2-Spin Systems
review_status: full-text audit complete; bounded-degree contraction premise, complex neighborhood, zero-free/correlation-decay conclusions, FPTAS implication, and related-work scope checked
venue_year_verified: Journal of Statistical Physics 185:12 (2021), DOI verified
evidence_note: A real contraction point for fixed maximum degree gives a complex zero-free/correlation-decay neighborhood and FPTAS for stated 2-spin settings; sufficient condition, not universal equivalence. Related work notes overlapping restricted results in Liu's thesis.

title: On Fairness and Stability in Two-Sided Matchings
review_status: full-text audit complete; Gale-Shapley composition counterexample, proto-metric positive regime, and algorithm-class-limited impossibility checked
evidence_note: Efficient fair/stable algorithms require fair hospital preferences and doctor distances in {0,1}; impossibility outside conditions applies to a specified natural algorithm class, not every conceivable algorithm.

title: Time and Energy Efficient Contention Resolution in Asynchronous Shared Channels
review_status: full-text audit complete; adaptive/known-k O(k) latency, unknown-k non-adaptive lower bound, near-matching protocol, and transmission-energy metric checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2022; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: O(k) latency is available with adaptivity or knowledge of k; without either, non-adaptive protocols face Ω(k log k/(log log k)^2) latency lower bound. Model-specific asymptotic result.

title: A computational phase diagram for the transverse field Ising model
review_status: full-text audit complete; Hamiltonian and parameter boundary, tractable partition-function/observable algorithms, hardness side, and recent-paper replication status checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-10-01; no venue or independent follow-up verified
